title: Planning with Files: Claude Code skill that brings workflow behind Manus straight into your terminal

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Want to work like the AI startup Meta just bought for $2 billion? Meet planning with files, a clawed code skill that brings the workflow behind manuse straight into your terminal. Here's the secret. Markdown as working memory. Instead of cramming everything into the AI's fragile context, you save notes, progress, and checkpoints on disk. Each file becomes a scratch pad, letting Claude remember what matters across tasks.
